budgetCalculator.title: Budget calculator
budgetCalculator.desc: The monthly and daily budget for your target, or what a fixed budget delivers.
budgetCalculator.long: Works from your real costs when you have data, or from estimates and a test plan when you do not. Costs rise as spend grows, so the budget accounts for diminishing returns.

leadFunnel.title: Lead funnel and CAC analysis
leadFunnel.desc: From cost per lead to cost per client, through booking, show-up and close rates.
leadFunnel.long: Turns client value and margin into the most you can pay per client (CAC) and per lead (CPL), then checks your real funnel against those limits.

ecomBreakEven.title: Ecommerce break-even and ROAS
ecomBreakEven.desc: Break-even CPA and ROAS after product cost, shipping, fees and returns.
ecomBreakEven.long: Shows exactly how much profit an order leaves for ads, judged on the first order or on lifetime value, with a target CPA that keeps a safety buffer.

testPlanner.title: New account test planner
testPlanner.desc: A test budget, daily spend and clear rules for what to do after the test.
testPlanner.long: For accounts without data: what you can afford to test, a stop-loss, and decision rules to scale, optimize or stop once real costs come in.

learningCheck.title: Learning phase check
learningCheck.desc: Checks that each Meta ad set and Google campaign gets enough results to learn.
learningCheck.long: Counts effective ad sets for CBO, ABO and Advantage+, compares results per ad set per week with the learning threshold and recommends how many ad sets your budget supports.

scalingTable.title: Scaling table
scalingTable.desc: Budget against results and cost per result, with the profitable limit marked.
scalingTable.long: Projects how cost per result rises as you scale and shows the highest monthly budget that still stays under break-even.

budgetSplit.title: Budget split planner
budgetSplit.desc: How much goes to Meta, Google Search, testing, retargeting and brand, and why.
budgetSplit.long: Allocates each step of budget to the platform with the lowest cost for the next result, respects platform minimums and adds a safe ramp schedule.

googleCeiling.title: Google search ceiling
googleCeiling.desc: The most Google Search can spend and deliver before costs climb.
googleCeiling.long: Uses search volume, impression share and impression share lost to budget to find where extra Google spend stops buying extra searches.

bottleneck.title: Bottleneck finder
bottleneck.desc: The weakest stage of your lead funnel and what fixing it is worth.
bottleneck.long: Tests a 10 point improvement at booking, show-up and close stages and shows the budget you would save, or the extra clients you would win.

showCalculation.title: Show the calculation
showCalculation.desc: Every number explained step by step, with your values filled in.
showCalculation.long: A timeline of each formula in plain language, with colour tags that separate your inputs, assumptions and settings, so you can defend the plan to a client.
